caption: The video captures a masked person in a brown jacket and blue gloves walking on grass in front of a wooden fence and dense trees. They hold two wands whose string loop is attached to a huge iridescent soap bubble spreading across the right side of the frame. As the person steps slowly leftward, the bubble stretches and changes shape, its surface shifting through rainbow colors while dark patches reveal the background. The loop gradually pulls away from the bubble's left edge, leaving a thin white tail at its lower boundary. After the separation, the string hangs down from the wands while the bubble remains airborne, its body still extending beyond the frame. The scene keeps the bubble partly beyond the frame, with the person still moving and the bubble visible.
relations: Person holding wands moves left -> soap bubble attached by string loop stretches and deforms.
Iridescent film thins as it stretches -> rainbow colors shift and dark patches reveal background.
String loop pulls away from bubble's left edge -> thin white tail remains at lower boundary.
After loop separates, bubble stays airborne beyond frame -> wands and hanging string remain visible.
